title: PepsiCo Declares $1.48 Quarterly Dividend, a 4% Increase
summary: PepsiCo declared a $1.48 quarterly dividend, up 4% from a year earlier, payable January 6, 2027 to shareholders of record on December 4, 2026.
body_markdown:
The company said the declaration is consistent with its previously announced increase in its annualized dividend to $5.92 per share from $5.69 per share. According to PepsiCo, that higher annualized rate began with the June 2026 payment.


## Why It Matters for PEP


The release places the payment within PepsiCo's dividend history. PepsiCo said it has paid consecutive quarterly cash dividends since 1965, and that 2026 marked the company's 54th consecutive annual dividend increase. The company described the $1.48 payment as a 4 percent increase versus the comparable year-earlier period.


For scale, PepsiCo said it generated nearly $94 billion in net revenue in 2025 from a beverage and convenient foods portfolio that includes Lay's, Doritos, Cheetos, Gatorade, Pepsi-Cola, Mountain Dew, Quaker and SodaStream. The company said its products are enjoyed by consumers more than one billion times a day in more than 200 countries and territories, and that many of its brands each generate more than $1 billion in estimated annual retail sales.
